Decision item 2 (commitment 2): distinguish steady-state vs mid-migration allowlist entries. Suggested phrasing: 'Per-invocation CLI-flag allowlist (--allowlist <comma-separated-paths>). Two intended usage modes: (a) steady-state allowlist entries (e.g., the synthesize carve-out output/synthesis-*/adrs/) passed at every dispatch of the consuming script - these are hard-coded into the dispatch site; (b) mid-migration allowlist entries (e.g., during in-flight Phase 2 folders) passed once and removed when the migration phase ends. user_escalations.summary: Bare-ID semantic-disambiguation scope decision for the 368 occurrences of 'ADR-0044' / 'ADR-0045' in repo prose. The Blueprint asserts 'No Ripple Effect' but ADR-0053 requires bare-ID updates for renumbered IDs. Each occurrence requires semantic check (does this prose mean the feature-scoped ADR being renumbered to 0051/0052, or the canonical ADR with different meaning?). User must ratify one of three scope options before Blueprint v1.1 FR-9 wording can finalize.

options.label: Accept full 368-occurrence sweep as Plan scope
options.effort: ~8-16 hours of semantic review per occurrence
options.risk: Plan effort balloons by orders of magnitude beyond the current 32-edit estimate
options.recommendation: NOT recommended per orchestrator dispatch brief

options.label: Heuristic-restricted sweep: bare-IDs inside working/feature/issue-capture-mechanism-r1/* default to feature-meaning (rewrite to 0051/0052); bare-IDs outside default to canonical-meaning (no edit)
options.effort: ~1-2 hours (estimated ~145 of 368 occurrences fall inside the heuristic boundary)
options.risk: Any cross-feature bare-ID reference outside issue-capture-mechanism-r1/* that meant the feature-scoped ADR is left stale
options.recommendation: RECOMMENDED per orchestrator dispatch brief; pragmatic middle ground

options.label: Defer bare-ID sweep entirely to a follow-up feature; capture as outside-pipeline issue per ADR-0049
options.risk: Stale bare-ID references confuse future readers until follow-up feature lands
options.recommendation: Available but not endorsed by orchestrator

user_escalations.user_action_required: Ratify one of option_i / option_ii / option_iii. Decision shapes Blueprint v1.1 FR-9 paragraph and Phase 3 Plan task. Blueprint v1.1 finalization is blocked on this decision (composer can draft other sections in parallel).
